clue.text: Title of lady in London adventure

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the run of words London adventure, spanning the gap between them

explanation.surface: A noblewoman caught up in some escapade in the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Doña is the Spanish honorific used before a married or noble woman's first name, the counterpart of Don.

clue.text: Sort involved with demo who tells us the end is nigh?

definitions.text: who tells us the end is nigh?

indicators.note: involved suggests things tangled together, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A type mixed up with a protest who warns of the apocalypse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort' looks like the anagram signal; 'involved' is, and SORT is fodder with DEMO.
explanation.definitionFit: A doomster is a prophet of doom, someone forecasting disaster or the world's end.

clue.text: Hint needed in a knotty situation? The opposite

indicators.note: needed in says the hint must be put inside the following pieces

parts.note: a node is a knot or knotty swelling, as on a stem
a tip is a helpful hint

explanation.surface: Advice is required when things get tangled; or rather, the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: An antipode is the exact opposite, literally the point on the far side of the globe.

clue.text: Fellow in something like Prodigal Son story not beyond redemption

indicators.note: in tells us the fellow is placed within the story-word that follows

parts.note: the Prodigal Son is one of Jesus's parables, a moral tale
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A forgiving tale like the Prodigal Son's, about a man who can still be saved.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forgivable or excusable is not beyond redemption.

clue.text: Theatre upset erstwhile actor

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word for theatre is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre
erstwhile means former, of an earlier time

explanation.surface: A one-time player annoyed with the playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor is one kind of performer, someone who entertains on stage.

clue.text: Trade times never altered in repeat notice

indicators.note: altered means changed, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A business's schedule is unchanged in a renewed announcement.
explanation.definitionFit: Running an advert again gives a second notice, a repeated public announcement.

clue.text: A river once more rising — this one at a border?

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means these pieces are read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river
again means once more

explanation.surface: A river swelling again, and this one sits on a frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niagara River, with its falls, forms part of the border between the US and Canada.

clue.text: Officers given hits feel unwell inside

indicators.note: inside says the feeling-unwell word is placed within the word for hits

parts.note: biffs are punches or blows
to ail is to be ill

explanation.surface: Police officers punched and feeling sick to the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Bailiffs are court officers who serve writs and seize goods.

clue.text: Spectators seeing six departing vessels

indicators.note: departing means the six leaves the word for spectators

parts.note: viewers are people watching, spectators
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Onlookers watch half a dozen ships sail away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessels' suggests ships; here it means jugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewers are large water jugs, containers or vessels for liquid.

clue.text: Old baddy leading men — a fine speaker?

indicators.note: leading says the old baddy comes in front of the men in the assembly

parts.note: a rat is a villainous or treacherous person
OR is short for other ranks, the ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Is a veteran villain at the head of his gang a good public speaker?
explanation.definitionFit: An orator is someone skilled at delivering formal public speeches, an eloquent speaker.

clue.text: Source of annoyance — clothes items I have being scratchy

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, so only its opening letter is taken

parts.note: bras are items of underclothing
contracted, I have becomes I've

explanation.surface: Some itchy garments are a real irritation to wear.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrasive things rub and scrape, so they feel rough or scratchy against the skin.

clue.text: Poet thus keeps mostly happy, animated within

indicators.note: keeps means the word for thus holds the other letters within it

parts.note: so is a synonym of thus

indicators.note: animated suggests lively movement, so the letters are jumbled
mostly means the word happy loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A poet who is, it seems, largely cheerful and lively inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeps ... within' is one container signal split around the fodder; 'mostly' drops the last letter before 'animated' jumbles what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Sappho of Lesbos was an ancient Greek lyric poet, famed for her love verse.

clue.text: Peculiarities are initially evident in very good stars

indicators.note: evident in says the following letter shows up inside the very good pair
initially picks out the first letter of the word are

parts.note: Aries, the Ram, is a constellation and sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Odd quirks show up in stars who are really good — perhaps in horoscopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Vagaries are unpredictable changes or whims, odd and erratic quirks of behaviour.

clue.text: What's conjured up by a dreamer may be rum

indicators.note: conjuring summons something new by magic, so the letters are transformed into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A daydreamer's fantasy might seem rather odd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the British slang for odd; it is the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Demerara rum is a dark spirit distilled in Guyana, named after the river there.

clue.text: Pressing after short break to be on the up again

indicators.note: after puts the pressing word behind the break
short means the break word loses its last letter

parts.note: a rest is a break
urgent means pressing, demanding attention

explanation.surface: Getting back to the urgent work after a brief pause, things improve.
explanation.definitionFit: Resurgent describes something rising or reviving again after decline.

clue.text: People run

definitions.meaning: an ethnic group or nation, a people of shared descent
to run competitively or at speed, as in a contest

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names an ethnic group or people; the verb means to sprint or compete at speed.

clue.text: Pet about to be given a bit of food

parts.note: CA, for circa, means about
a noodle is a strip of pasta, a little piece of food

explanation.surface: A pet animal about to get a treat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pet' looks like a noun, an animal; it is the verb, to fondle.
explanation.definitionFit: To canoodle is to kiss and cuddle amorously, to pet.

clue.text: Duck on huge lake in city

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the duck after the other pieces

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, a clothing size for very large
L is the map abbreviation for lake
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, written as O

explanation.surface: A duck swimming on a vast lake somewhere in town.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital of Norway, a Scandinavian city on a fjord.

clue.text: Seats of old empire gone with onset of socialism

parts.note: the Ottoman Empire was the Turkish empire that ended in 1922

indicators.note: the onset is the beginning, so only the first letter of socialism is used

explanation.surface: Seats of the old imperial regime were lost to the rise of socialism.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottomans are low upholstered seats or footstools without backs or arms.

clue.text: Exaggerate the merits of maidens possibly facing 'orrible situation

parts.note: in cricket a maiden is an over with no runs scored, so maidens are an example of overs
hell with the H dropped, as a Cockney might say it, to match the dropped H in 'orrible

explanation.surface: Bigging up young women when things are actually dire.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversell something is to praise or promote it beyond what it deserves.

clue.text: Provide group with tuition — something children enjoy

definitions.meaning: to coach or instruct a class, i.e. to teach a group of pupils
a model railway, a classic toy for youngsters

explanation.surface: Teaching a class can be fun for the youngsters.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer is an instruction: coach (train) a group (set).
explanation.definitionFit: A toy railway layout with engines and track is a favourite plaything; read as two words it means coaching a class.

clue.text: Go on to Doncaster bypass maybe and prepare to shoot ahead

parts.note: to take a road is to go on to it
the A1(M) motorway runs past Doncaster in England; with the 1 read as I it spells these letters

explanation.surface: Join the motorway around Doncaster and get ready to race ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Sighting a weapon at a target before firing is readying a shot forward.

clue.text: Military barrier could be made by cadets, OK?

indicators.note: could be made by suggests these letters can be reworked into something new

explanation.surface: Trainee soldiers asking if they can build a defensive fence.
explanation.definitionFit: A stockade is a protective wall of upright wooden posts built for defence.

clue.text: Yell not acceptable after request for silence

indicators.note: after places the not-acceptable word behind the request for silence

parts.note: sh is the sound made to ask for quiet
out means unacceptable, not allowed

explanation.surface: Being told to hush is unwelcome when one wants to bellow.
explanation.definitionFit: To shout is to yell, to cry out loudly.

clue.text: One offering high-level protection

parts.note: sounds like a bodyguard or senior security service, but literally describes a tradesman who covers the tops of houses

explanation.surface: A security expert guarding the most important people.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who builds or repairs the covering on top of buildings protects them from weather from above.

clue.text: Order one sent out for military supplies

indicators.note: sent out means a piece is dismissed from the word for order

parts.note: an ordinance is an official decree or order
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Commanding a single soldier to fetch army supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance means weapons, ammunition and military stores collectively.

clue.text: Pass with low exam grade — fall from high standard?

parts.note: E is a low grade in British exams
a lapse is a slip or decline from one's usual standards

explanation.surface: Scraping through with a poor mark — a disappointing slip for a good student.
explanation.definitionFit: When time passes or goes by, it is said to elapse.

clue.text: Hot matters to be dealt with? One can control the heat

indicators.note: dealing with something rearranges it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Urgent, heated issues need handling by someone who can calm things down.
explanation.definitionFit: A thermostat is a device that switches heating on and off to keep a set temperature.

clue.text: Dirty son with something greasy

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
oil is a greasy substance

explanation.surface: A boy covered in grease.
explanation.definitionFit: To soil something is to make it dirty or stain it.
